From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@gwave.com>

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC integration — architecture walkthrough request

Hi Laura,

We're starting the internal design for a sequestered VPC deployment for GreenWave's inference tier and would like a joint walkthrough of Redwood's control plane/data plane reference and any egress constraints. Key asks:
- A short (30m) architecture walkthrough for our infra and security teams.
- Reference diagrams showing control plane placement, KV cache boundaries, and recommended egress patterns.
- A short list of deployment constraints (cert rotation, KMS integration, audit logging endpoints).

We're aiming to kick off next week. Availability: Mon/Tue afternoons PT. Copying our lead infra architect (design@greenwave.com).

Thanks,
Sam Taylor
Head of Platform, GreenWave Systems

Hi Sam — thanks for the note. We can run a 30m walkthrough on Monday, May 17 at 2:30pm PT. Agenda I propose:
1) High-level control plane vs data plane topology (how we place the control plane in your VPC or a customer-managed control plane)
2) KV cache and inference node attachment patterns (prefix caching + hot-key considerations)
3) Egress and audit/logging channels (KMS, syslog, trace collectors)
4) Deployment checklist and handoff artifacts

I've attached a preliminary diagram and a skeleton playbook to seed the discussion. If that time works I'll share a short invite and a Confluence link with artifacts.

Looking forward,

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC integration — pre-call notes

Laura / team — quick pre-call notes after skimming GreenWave's requirements:
- Control plane placement: if GreenWave requires customer-managed control plane (for data residency) we need to confirm the minimal public endpoints (OAuth, heartbeat) or a proxy pattern.
- KV cache boundary: recommend co-locating KV cache with inference nodes in the sequestered subnet; fallback to a shared managed cache only if latency/size constraints demand it.
- Egress: we must confirm KMS endpoints (HSM or cloud KMS) and whether traffic can route to our telemetry collectors. If not, we need a sidecar forwarder pattern.
- Networking ask: will GreenWave allow BFD and BGP sessions for high-availability? if not, we need an overlaid VPN failover plan.

I'll bring the control/data matrix file to the call (controlplane-dataplane-matrix.xlsx).

Rishi
Lead, Inference Platform
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@gwave.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@aurora-net.com>, design@greenwave.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC integration — architecture walkthrough request

Thanks, Laura and Rishi — the time works. A few clarifications before the call:
- GreenWave will not permit public outbound to third-party telemetry collectors; we can push logs to our internal aggregator.
- KMS will be customer-managed via an on-prem HSM reachable over a private link.
- BGP is allowed for colo-to-cloud tunnels; for our remote edge sites we will prefer mTLS over site-to-site VPN.

Please hold the session to an architecture + constraints discussion — deep implementation can follow.

Sam
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@gwave.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Sequestered VPC walkthrough — action log and next steps

Sam / GreenWave team,

Great walkthrough today — notes and agreed next steps below. I've attached the updated diagram (v1.1) and the control/data matrix we discussed.

Summary (high level):
- Control plane model: customer-managed control plane (private control plane inside GreenWave VPC) + Redwood agent-based connectors for telemetry and metrics. No public control endpoints required; we will run a short-lived reverse-tunnel for initial bootstrap if onboarding automation is used.
- Data plane model: inference nodes (gpu pool) in sequestered private subnets, KV cache co-located with the node group. Cross-zone replication optional; prefer single-zone for lowest latency initially.
- KMS & keys: integrate with customer HSM over private link. Key rotations must be coordinated; Redwood will provide key-rotation hooks and a short RFC for scheduling.
- Telemetry: GreenWave will host an internal log/trace aggregator. Redwood will push via a local sidecar forwarder that writes to a customer-facing endpoint (no public egress).
- Failover: main option is BGP over colo links; for edge sites we will use mTLS tunnels between edge gateway and Redwood relay plane.

Action items:
1) Laura: Share updated diagram and playbook (attached). (due 2027-05-21)
2) Rishi: Draft a minimal bootstrap sequence for the reverse-tunnel option and RBAC mappings. (due 2027-05-24)
3) Neha: Confirm observability sidecar resource footprint for typical inference nodes and provide sizing guidance. (due 2027-05-24)
4) Jonas: Validate BGP FT/keepalive requirements with networking team and provide suggested timers. (due 2027-05-26)
5) Sam/Amit (GreenWave): Confirm whether cross-zone replication is allowed for KV cache and provide HSM maintenance windows. (due 2027-05-25)

Attachments: controlplane-dataplane-matrix.xlsx, sequestered-vpc-diagram-v1.1.png, deployment-playbook-draft.md

Action links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ASequesteredVPC (design artifacts)

Thanks — short follow-up sync next Tuesday to go through the bootstrap sequence.

—Laura
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
